items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: So in other words I had the same guys. And then Al Plank is this piano player, this wonderful musician.

ctx.x: Oh I like those kind of gigs. I have one at home actually.

Oh yeah? You know what I’m talking about. I mean and so I did it with Bruce Forman, a great guitarist for several years because we were neighbors. And then he left the area, he’s now living in Carmel Valley. So he’s not available. And I had another piano player right after him for several years. So in other words I had the same guys. And then Al Plank is this piano player, this wonderful musician. And he had some surgery last I guess December and he’s recovered but he just doesn’t want to do anything right now.…
Great. I’ll have to see if I can get in there before we leave here.
